chosen_edition: The St. Gregory Hymnal and Catholic Choir Book (1920), no. 5

editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: This melody edition prints five stanzas interlined with the music (pp. 7-8) and a refrain marked for stanzas 1-5; the refrain is given once after stanza 1 and syllable hyphens are rejoined. It has 'heights sublime' and omits the shepherd-dialogue stanzas found in longer versions, adding a closing stanza to Mary.
